home.title: QualLoop
home.subtitle: App shell is ready. Screens arrive in later phases.

problem.title: We could not finish that
problem.detail: The server sent an answer we could not read, so nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tell support.

reason.required: Give a reason. It is kept with the change.
reason.tooLong: The reason is too long. Keep it under 2,000 characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Use the email and password your admin set up for QualLoop.

bad.title: We could not sign you in
bad.detail: The email or password is not right. Nothing was changed. Check both and try again.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Enter your work email. If it has an account, we send a 6-digit code to it.
reset.sent: If that email has an account, we have sent a 6-digit code to it. The code works for 10 minutes. Enter it below.
reset.doneDetail: Your new password is set. Sign in with it now.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.noMatch: No suppliers match this search or these filters. Change the words or clear a filter.

empty.title: No suppliers yet
empty.body: Add a supplier with the button above, or import your supplier list from a spreadsheet.
empty.viewerBody: Suppliers appear here once a Quality user adds them.

form.name: Name
form.gstinHelp: Optional. Leave blank if the supplier has no GSTIN.
form.statusHelpLimited: Only an approver can start a supplier on another status.

errors.name: Enter the supplier name.
errors.gstin: GSTIN must have 15 letters or digits. Check it against the GST certificate.
errors.category: Choose a category for this supplier.
errors.status: Choose a status for this supplier.

noPermission.title: You do not have permission to change suppliers
noPermission.detail: Viewers can read supplier records but not change them. Ask a Quality user or an Admin.

detail.onlyApprovers: Only a user who can approve may change a supplier's status.
detail.archivedDetail: It was archived on {date}. Its records are kept.

statusDialog.title: Change status
statusDialog.consequence: The new status applies to this supplier straight away. It is recorded with your name and your reason.

archiveDialog.title: Archive supplier
archiveDialog.consequence: The supplier disappears from lists and pickers. Its receipts, cases and contacts are kept.

empty.title: No contacts yet
empty.body: Add the person who should get 8D requests from this supplier. A mobile number or an email is enough to start.
empty.viewerBody: Contacts appear here once a Quality user adds them.

add.title: Add contact
add.intro: Add a mobile number, an email, or both. You verify them next.

edit.title: Edit contact
edit.consequence: Changing a mobile number or an email clears its verification.

errors.name: Enter the contact's name.
errors.contact: Add a mobile number or an email.
errors.mobile: Use the international format, for example +919876543210.

verify.title: Verify {name}
verify.chooseIntro: We send a 6-digit code. It works for 10 minutes.
verify.enterIntro: Enter the 6-digit code the contact received.
verify.noDestination: This contact has no mobile number or email to verify. Edit the contact first.
verify.doneDetail: The contact is verified on this channel.

consents.title: Consents for {name}
consents.intro: Record whether the contact agreed to get messages on each channel. An opt-out takes effect at once.

replace.title: Replace {name}
replace.consequence: {name} is disabled and the new contact takes over, including the quality contact role. The old contact and its history stay on record.

disable.title: Disable contact
disable.consequence: {name} will no longer get messages or be able to open supplier links. The contact and its history stay on record.

empty.title: No parts yet
empty.body: Add a part with the button above, or import your part list from a spreadsheet.
empty.viewerBody: Parts appear here once a Quality user adds them.

noPermission.title: You do not have permission to change parts
noPermission.detail: Viewers can read parts but not change them. Ask a Quality user or an Admin.

detail.archivedDetail: It was archived on {date}. Its records are kept.

archiveDialog.title: Archive part
archiveDialog.consequence: The part disappears from lists and pickers. Its links, receipts and cases are kept.

empty.title: No suppliers linked
empty.body: Link the suppliers who make this part, and set a PPM target for each one.

unlinkDialog.title: Unlink supplier
unlinkDialog.body: {name} stops being a supplier of this part. The link is archived and can be restored by linking again.

linkDialog.title: Link supplier
linkDialog.intro: Search for the supplier, choose it, and set the PPM target if it differs from the default.
linkDialog.ppmHelp: A whole number above 0. Leave blank to use the default.

errors.ppm: Use a whole number above 0, for example 500.

editDialog.title: Edit link with {name}
editDialog.ppmHelp: A whole number above 0. Leave blank to use the default.
editDialog.ppmError: Use a whole number above 0, for example 500.

empty.title: No customers linked
empty.body: Link the customers who use this part. One part can serve many customers.

unlinkDialog.title: Unlink customer
unlinkDialog.body: {name} stops being linked to this part. The link is archived and can be restored by linking again.

linkDialog.title: Link customer
linkDialog.intro: Choose a customer, or add a new one.

empty.title: No imports yet
empty.body: Import suppliers, parts or supplier parts from an Excel or CSV file. You review every row before anything is saved.

noPermission.title: You do not have permission to import files
noPermission.detail: Imports are for Quality users and Admins. Ask one of them to import this file for you.

upload.title: Upload file
upload.intro: Choose what you are importing and the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
upload.fileHelp: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 20 MB. Only the first sheet is read, and row 1 must hold the column names.

wrongType.title: That file type is not accepted
wrongType.detail: Nothing was uploaded. Save the sheet as an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv) file and choose it again.

size.title: That file is empty or larger than 20 MB
size.detail: Nothing was uploaded. Split a large file into smaller ones, or choose a file that has rows.

scan.title: We are still checking your file
scan.detail: The virus check is taking longer than usual. Nothing was imported. Wait a minute and upload the file again.

put.title: Your file could not be sent
put.detail: The file did not reach storage, so nothing was imported. Check your connection and upload it again.

map.title: Map columns
map.intro: Match each QualLoop field to a column in {name}. Required fields must be matched.

seenBefore.title: This file was uploaded before
seenBefore.detail: Nothing has been processed yet. Look at the previous import first, or carry on if you mean to import it again.

validate.title: Checking rows
validate.working: Checking every row against your data

slow.title: This is taking longer than usual
slow.detail: The work is still running on the server and your file is safe. Reload this page in a minute to see where it got to.

confirm.title: Confirm import
confirm.partialTitle: Some rows will not be imported
confirm.partialDetail: Duplicates, errors, unmapped rows and rows that need review are never imported or merged. They are listed in the report.
confirm.accept: Import valid rows only. The other {skipped} rows are skipped and listed in the report.
confirm.clean: All {count} rows are valid and will be imported.

result.title: Import complete
result.mismatchTitle: The counts do not add up
result.mismatchDetail: The rows imported and skipped do not add up to the rows received. Download the report and tell support.
result.failedHeadline: The import stopped before it finished
result.failedDetail: Some rows may already be imported, and the report shows which. Nothing else was changed. Start a new import to retry the rest.
result.cancelledDetail: This import was cancelled and nothing was saved.
